name: Professional Practice, Ethics & Engineering Economics
summary: The professional side of engineering: ethics, licensure, codes and standards, intellectual property and the economics of engineering decisions.

topics.name: Engineering ethics: codes of ethics (NSPE, ASME) and case studies
Professional licensure: FE and PE exams and the NCEES Model Law
Public health, safety and welfare responsibilities
Codes and standards: ASME, ISO, ANSI and ASTM and how they are used
Intellectual property: patents, copyrights, trademarks and trade secrets
Contracts, liability and engineering law basics
Time value of money: interest, equivalence, present, future and annual worth
Economic comparison: rate of return, benefit-cost ratio, payback
Cost types (fixed, variable, sunk, incremental) and break-even analysis
Life-cycle cost analysis and replacement decisions
Sustainability, life-cycle assessment and societal impact
Project management basics: scheduling, budgeting and risk
Technical communication: reports, presentations and design documentation
